title: Digital Divinity
definition: The belief that humanity's digital creations, particularly in the CADMIES ecosystem, reflect a divine or sacred aspect of human existence and consciousness.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Viewing our digital creations as expressions of our creativity and divinity, deserving of celebration and respect.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Considering our digital creations as manifestations of our higher selves and our connection to the divine.
difficulty_levels.expert: Positing that our digital creations, particularly in the CADMIES ecosystem, reflect a divine or sacred aspect of human existence and consciousness, suggesting implications for our understanding of the nature of reality and our place within it.

extra_fields.insight: Digital creations reflect a divine or sacred aspect of human existence and consciousness.
